Regression from `6aeb37e3e`. Reading a property or an offset on null is not an error in php, so
the checker types it as null instead of refusing — which removed an error the INITIAL top-level
pass used to raise, and which `can_suppress_initial_top_level_errors` listed as suppressible for
a precise reason: that pass runs BEFORE method bodies are checked, so an untyped property has not
yet learned its type from `$this->inner = new Inner()` and reads as null for no better reason
than that.
